exact_statements.PqxdhKeyScheduleFromRoot.fromRoot_bound:
theorem fromRoot_bound (source : FixedHkdfSha512NoSaltSource) (hmac : HmacSha512)
    (correct : SourceFullCorrect source hmac) (distinguisher : Distinguisher) :
    (rootHybrid source distinguisher).boolDistAdvantage
        (PqxdhServerAuthKeySchedule.uniformGame distinguisher) ≤
      (extractRealGame hmac uniform32 (initExtractReduction source hmac distinguisher)).boolDistAdvantage
          (extractUniformGame uniform32 (initExtractReduction source hmac distinguisher)) +
        (hmacPrfRealGame hmac (initExpandReduction source distinguisher)).boolDistAdvantage
          (hmacPrfRandomGame (initExpandReduction source distinguisher)) +
        (extractRealGame hmac uniform32 (stepExtractReduction hmac distinguisher)).boolDistAdvantage
          (extractUniformGame uniform32 (stepExtractReduction hmac distinguisher)) +
        (hmacPrfRealGame hmac (stepExpandReduction distinguisher)).boolDistAdvantage
          (hmacPrfRandomGame (stepExpandReduction distinguisher))
exact_statements.PqxdhKeyScheduleFromRoot.fromRoot_bound_:
theorem fromRoot_bound_context {Context : Type} (source : FixedHkdfSha512NoSaltSource)
    (hmac : HmacSha512) (correct : SourceFullCorrect source hmac) (sample : ProbComp Context)
    (distinguisher : Context → Distinguisher) :
    (do let context ← sample
        let root ← $ᵗ RootOutput
        distinguisher context (fromRoot source root)).boolDistAdvantage
      (do let context ← sample
          let output ← $ᵗ Output
          distinguisher context output) ≤
      (extractRealGame hmac uniform32
          (initExtractReduction source hmac (withContext sample distinguisher))).boolDistAdvantage
          (extractUniformGame uniform32
            (initExtractReduction source hmac (withContext sample distinguisher))) +
        (hmacPrfRealGame hmac (initExpandReduction source (withContext sample distinguisher))).boolDistAdvantage
          (hmacPrfRandomGame (initExpandReduction source (withContext sample distinguisher))) +
        (extractRealGame hmac uniform32
            (stepExtractReduction hmac (withContext sample distinguisher))).boolDistAdvantage
          (extractUniformGame uniform32 (stepExtractReduction hmac (withContext sample distinguisher))) +
        (hmacPrfRealGame hmac (stepExpandReduction (withContext sample distinguisher))).boolDistAdvantage
          (hmacPrfRandomGame (stepExpandReduction (withContext sample distinguisher)))
exact_statements.PqxdhRootFirstEntry.eager_first:
theorem eager_first {α : Type} (client : OracleComp (unifSpec + (D →ₒ R)) α) (state : State D R) :
    𝒮[(simulateQ trackedImpl client).run state] =
      𝒮[do let value ← $ᵗ R; (simulateQ (eagerImpl value) client).run state]
exact_statements.PqxdhRootFirstEntry.lazy_first:
theorem lazy_first {α : Type} (client : OracleComp (unifSpec + (D →ₒ R)) α)
    (cache : (D →ₒ R).QueryCache) :
    𝒮[(simulateQ lazyImpl client).run cache] =
      𝒮[do let value ← $ᵗ R
           Prod.map id Prod.fst <$> (simulateQ (eagerImpl value) client).run (cache, none)]
exact_statements.PqxdhRootFirstEntry.first_cached:
theorem first_cached {α : Type} (value : R) (client : OracleComp (unifSpec + (D →ₒ R)) α)
    (state : State D R) (start : ∀ first, state.2 = some first → state.1 first = some value) :
    ∀ result ∈ support ((simulateQ (eagerImpl value) client).run state),
      ∀ first, result.2.2 = some first → result.2.1 first = some value
exact_statements.PqxdhRootFirstEntry.uniformGame_first:
theorem uniformGame_first (client : OracleComp RootSpec Bool) :
    𝒟[PqxdhCorrelatedExpandHybrid.uniformGame client] =

           (simulateQ (eagerImpl root) client).run' (∅, none)]
exact_statements.PqxdhExtractRomHiddenSuffix.hidden_suffi:
theorem hidden_suffix_bound {C : Type} (start : ProbComp (HmacOracle.QueryCache × C))
    (client : C → OracleComp HiddenSpec Bool) (Q : ℕ)
    (keys : HmacOracle.QueryCache × C → Finset Pqxdh.Bytes) (residual : HmacOracle.QueryCache × C → ℕ)
    (covers : ∀ p ∈ support start, ∀ x, p.1 x ≠ none → x ∈ keys p)
    (bounded : ∀ p ∈ support start, (client p.2).IsQueryBoundP IsDirect (residual p))
    (total : ∀ p ∈ support start, (keys p).card + residual p ≤ Q) :
    (sharedGame start client).boolDistAdvantage (splitGame start client) ≤ (Q : ℝ) / 2 ^ 256
exact_statements.PqxdhExtractRomHiddenSuffix.prefix_tvDis:
theorem prefix_tvDist {α : Type} (oa : OracleComp HiddenSpec α) (cache : HmacOracle.QueryCache)
    (keys : Finset Pqxdh.Bytes) (residual : ℕ) (covers : ∀ point, cache point ≠ none → point ∈ keys)
    (bounded : oa.IsQueryBoundP IsDirect residual) :
    tvDist (do let secret ← $ᵗ MlKemSharedSecret; (simulateQ (sharedImpl secret) oa).run' cache)
        (do let _secret ← $ᵗ MlKemSharedSecret; (simulateQ splitImpl oa).run' (cache, ∅)) ≤
      ((keys.card + residual : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 ^ 256
exact_statements.PqxdhExtractRomHiddenSuffix.flagged_tvDi:
theorem flagged_tvDist {α : Type} (secret : MlKemSharedSecret) (oa : OracleComp HiddenSpec α)
    (tables : Tables) :
    tvDist ((simulateQ (sharedFlag secret) oa).run (tables, false))
        ((simulateQ (splitFlag secret) oa).run (tables, false)) ≤
      Pr[fun result : α × Tables × Bool => result.2.2 = true |
        (simulateQ (splitFlag secret) oa).run (tables, false)].toReal
exact_statements.PqxdhExtractRomHiddenSuffix.guess_finset:
theorem guess_finset_le (points : Finset Pqxdh.Bytes) :
    Pr[fun secret => ∃ point ∈ points, (coordinate secret point).isSome | $ᵗ MlKemSharedSecret] ≤
      points.card * (2 ^ 256 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹

    (oa : OracleComp spec α) (state : σ) :

theorem layered {ι₁ ι₂ ι₃ O α : Type} {specR : OracleSpec ι₁} {spec₁ : OracleSpec ι₂} {spec₂ : OracleSpec ι₃}
    {m : Type → Type} [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m]
    (client₁ : QueryImpl specR (StateT O (OracleComp spec₁))) (client₂ : QueryImpl specR (StateT O (OracleComp spec₂)))
    (impl₁ : QueryImpl spec₁ m) (impl₂ : QueryImpl spec₂ m)
    (step : ∀ query owners, simulateQ impl₁ ((client₁ query).run owners) = simulateQ impl₂ ((client₂ query).run owners))
    (work : OracleComp specR α) (owners : O) :
    simulateQ impl₁ ((simulateQ client₁ work).run owners) = simulateQ impl₂ ((simulateQ client₂ work).run owners)
